rationale.reason: Complete diesel road tractors for semi-trailers fit 8701.21; the trailer is a separate product.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR covers manufacture of new complete diesel road tractors equipped with a fifth-wheel coupling to tow semi-trailers. Start at documented material/component receipt at the reporting manufacturing site and stop after configuration-specific factory acceptance at the declared dispatch gate. It is a foreground receipt-to-dispatch manufacturing module; matching upstream production links and explicit coverage are necessary before a complete cradle-to-gate claim. [Sources: `scania-production`, `volvo-spec`, `jost-fifth`]

Exclude semi-trailers, cargo, rigid trucks, agricultural/terminal tractors, buses, battery-electric, hybrid and gas-powered tractors, bare engine-fitted chassis sold as incomplete vehicles, repairs/refurbishment, dealer installation, freight operation, maintenance and end of life. The narrower diesel boundary is deliberate: different propulsion architectures require different component and testing rules. Existing motor-vehicle body methodology addresses a component, not this complete tractor. A fitted bought-in cab is counted once; if manufactured on site, explicitly include body/fitting operations and omit that purchase. No transport service or tonne-kilometre reference is covered.
reviewed_boundary.covered: New complete diesel fifth-wheel-equipped road tractors, with axle/cab/powertrain configuration declared
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Trailers, rigid trucks, incomplete chassis, alternative propulsion tractors and transport services
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Accepted complete tractor at declared factory dispatch gate

authored_review_metadata.semantic_boundary_decision: Separate configured new diesel road tractor final manufacture from existing vehicle-body component PCR. Covers complete fifth-wheel-equipped road tractor, excludes semi-trailer and rigid truck, electric/hybrid/gas powertrains. Purchased finished cab is counted once; its manufacture remains supplier upstream, or actual foreground cab stages are modelled explicitly without duplicate cab purchase.

unresolved_quantity_ranges: No verified same-configuration net M or boundary-compatible independent manufacturing intensity ranges; foreground measurements must establish amounts and QA limits.
evidence_limitations: Diesel-only manufacturing boundary narrower than CPC leaf; no classification mapping acceptance is claimed.
Reference product identity unresolved; freight service and trailers are incompatible.
Manufacturer configuration/process examples do not establish universally mandatory recipes, actual fill mass or vehicle lifetime.
Scania future 2025 Q4 Powertrain statement is not evidence of completed/current plant output.
Every actual BOM exchange and demonstrated species must be added before dataset completion; supplier upstream must be linked before complete cradle-to-gate claims.

Road-engine public identity establishes motor-vehicle propulsion and Mass/kg, not actual supplier completeness or prefill amounts. Independently measured body/accessory/prefill/installed-assembly masses must reconcile to the same VIN and measured M; supplier-prefilled fluids are not repeated as first-fill inputs.

rejected_flow_identities.reason: Public class43110 explicitly excludes motor vehicles and aircraft; this non-motor-vehicle engine cannot represent road-tractor propulsion. Its Number of items does not establish the replacement engine Mass/kg numerator.

engine_flow_identity.scope: One supplied compression-ignition piston engine for declared diesel road-tractor propulsion, with actual engine-body/accessory and retained-prefill scope measured and reconciled to installed assembly and complete vehicle M.
engine_flow_identity.remaining_evidence_needs: Actual supplied/installed engine kg, independent engine-body/component weighing, supplier prefill composition/retained kg, drained/returned and separately added fluid, VIN BOM and complete-vehicle M require foreground records; identity is not a measured quantity or fixed per-engine weight.
